env.label: local laptop, AC power, Windows power plan Balanced, NVMe SSD (NTFS), %TEMP% on C:
env.build: MinGW-w64 g++ 15.1.0 (MSYS2 mingw64, msvcrt); -O2 -std=c++17 -D__USE_MINGW_ANSI_STDIO=1; libtblog_static.a built -O2 -fvisibility=hidden with zlib
env.build_facts: optimized, stdio: mingw-w64 on msvcrt (__USE_MINGW_ANSI_STDIO=1: mingw's own C99 printf), tblog: static library

config.e2e_definition: tblog: start until tblog_shutdown() returns (drain + fsync + close); fprintf: start until fflush + fsync + fclose return

variants.fprintf_buffered: fprintf to one shared FILE* opened "wb", default stdio buffering (the C library locks the stream per call)
variants.snprintf_fwrite: snprintf of the same line into a stack buffer + one fwrite to the shared FILE* (default buffering)
variants.tblog_block: TBLOG_INFO, default config except file only (console=false, reload.watch=false, file.max_size=4GB), full_policy=block
variants.tblog_drop: TBLOG_INFO, default config except file only (console=false, reload.watch=false, file.max_size=4GB), full_policy=drop (the default)
variants.printf_if_guard: if (atomic<bool> debug_enabled /* false */) fprintf(...): the filtered printf call
variants.tblog_below_level: TBLOG_DEBUG(...) with level = INFO: the filtered tblog call
